verdict.rationale: The README shows `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF` and `llama serve -hf ...`, so models can be pulled directly from Hugging Face by repo name on the command line. That covers the download part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows searching for models or managing them locally (listing, deleting, updating cached models). Missing for 10: model search from the CLI, local model management commands (list/remove/update), and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the -hf download workflow.
